messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Has anyone successfully deployed an app that uses the ggvis package to shinyapps.io?
parts:
It should definitely work.  What version of dplyr are you running? 
If you can send the error output you see and the output of sessionInfo() that would be helpful. 

On Sunday, February 22, 2015, Isaac Miller <isaacmi...@gmail.com> wrote:
I have a pretty simple Shiny app that works great in RStudio, but won't upload to shinyapps.io.  The deployApp() function pauses at "building: Building package: dplyr" and then spits out a wall of error text.  I have successfully deployed several other apps to shinyapps.io and the only difference from this one seems to be that I use ggvis.  dplyr is required for ggvis (I think) so that's why deployApp() is installing it.

So, I'm just trying to figure out if I should keep troubleshooting or if ggvis and/or dplyr are known to not work with shinyapps.io.

Any assistance is appreciated.

Thanks!
